Welcome to Bella's magical animated birthday celebration website!
This website is crafted exclusively with pure HTML5 and CSS3 (zero JavaScript,
zero dependencies, 100% clean and ultra-fast).

------------------------------------------------------------------------
📁 PROJECT FILE STRUCTURE
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Bella-Birthday-JB-Technology/
│
├── index.html                  --> Main magical birthday webpage
├── style.css                   --> Pure CSS3 animations, themes & layouts
├── README.txt                  --> This guide and deployment instructions
│
├── images/
│   └── bella-photo.jpg         --> Bella's beautiful photo (Active)
│
├── videos/
│   └── birthday-background.mp4 --> Optional background video
│
└── music/
    └── birthday-music.mp3      --> Optional birthday background music


------------------------------------------------------------------------
🎵 HOW TO ADD OPTIONAL MUSIC & VIDEO
------------------------------------------------------------------------

1. BACKGROUND MUSIC (Optional):
   - Copy any MP3 song (e.g., Happy Birthday song) into the "music/" folder.
   - Name the file: birthday-music.mp3
   - Open index.html in your browser and click the Play (▶) button on the
     floating music bar at the top-right corner to enjoy the song.
   - Note: Modern web browsers require user interaction to play sound to
     comply with web standards and prevent unwanted blaring audio.

2. BACKGROUND VIDEO (Optional):
   - Copy any MP4 video (e.g., fairy dust, magical bokeh, floating balloons)
     into the "videos/" folder.
   - Name the file: birthday-background.mp4
   - The webpage will automatically loop the video smoothly with a soft
     translucent overlay so all text and photos remain crystal-clear.
   - If no video file is provided, the website runs smoothly with its built-in
     pure CSS magical starry animated gradient background!

3. BELLA'S PHOTO:
   - Bella's real photo is already included in "images/bella-photo.jpg".
   - If you ever wish to replace it, simply put a new photo in the "images/"
     folder with the filename "bella-photo.jpg".


------------------------------------------------------------------------
💻 HOW TO RUN LOCALLY ON WINDOWS
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Method 1 (Simplest):
1. Open File Explorer and navigate to:
   E:\Bella_birthday\Bella-Birthday-JB-Technology\
2. Double-click on "index.html".
3. It will immediately open in Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, or Firefox!

Method 2 (Using Local Web Server):
1. Open PowerShell or Command Prompt.
2. Run:
   npx serve E:\Bella_birthday\Bella-Birthday-JB-Technology
3. Open the localhost URL in your browser.


------------------------------------------------------------------------
🚀 HOW TO DEPLOY TO VERCEL (FREE & INSTANT)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Method 1 (Command Line / Terminal):
1. Open PowerShell or Command Prompt.
2. Navigate to this folder:
   cd E:\Bella_birthday\Bella-Birthday-JB-Technology
3. Run:
   npx vercel
4. Log in if prompted (follow the on-screen link to authorize in your browser).
5. Accept defaults by pressing ENTER.
6. For production release:
   npx vercel --prod

Method 2 (Vercel Dashboard / Git):
1. Push this folder to GitHub (e.g., "bella-birthday").
2. Go to https://vercel.com/new and import the repo.
3. Click "Deploy" — Vercel will instantly generate a live HTTPS link!


------------------------------------------------------------------------
🚀 HOW TO PUBLISH ONLINE USING NETLIFY DROP (FREE & INSTANT)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
You can turn this into a live, shareable link on the internet in 60 seconds:

Step 1:
Open your browser and visit:
https://app.netlify.com/drop

Step 2:
Drag and drop the entire folder:
"Bella-Birthday-JB-Technology"
directly into the Netlify Drop browser window.

Step 3:
Netlify will instantly upload and generate a live public URL (e.g.,
https://bellas-magical-birthday.netlify.app).

Step 4:
Copy the link and send it to Bella and family! Anyone on mobile, tablet,
or desktop anywhere in the world can open and enjoy it.
